services.summary: A managed backup and disaster-recovery control plane for application-consistent protection, vaulting and recovery of supported workloads.
concepts: backup/recovery appliance or agent, backup vault, plan/profile, snapshot and recovery point define the Backup and DR Service resource and control model.
The service flow is protected workload > scheduled capture > immutable/controlled vault > restore mount/copy > recovery validation.
Backup and DR Service provides managed controls, while workload owners retain data classification, business authorization and recovery accountability.
applicationFit: Choose Backup and DR Service when a managed backup and disaster-recovery control plane for application-consistent protection, vaulting and recovery of supported workloads.
It best fits architectures that need protected workload > scheduled capture > immutable/controlled vault > restore mount/copy > recovery validation.
Choose a successful backup is not proven recovery; test application-consistent restores and regional failure procedures instead when that alternative's responsibility model dominates.

consoleSteps.detail: Exercise protected workload > scheduled capture > immutable/controlled vault > restore mount/copy > recovery validation; confirm findings, logs, alerts or recovery evidence.

security: Limit Backup and DR Service administration and runtime access to the roles required for backup/recovery appliance or agent, backup vault, plan/profile, snapshot and recovery point.
Separate policy/key/evidence administrators where Backup and DR Service can affect access, cryptography, findings or recovery.
Protect logs, findings, secrets, certificates and exported evidence according to their sensitivity.
operations: Monitor Backup and DR Service policy status, failures, quota and evidence freshness.
Version and peer-review backup/recovery appliance or agent, backup vault, plan/profile, snapshot and recovery point; test representative allow, deny, failure and recovery paths.
Assign owners for exceptions, findings, key/secret rotation, regional events and incident response.
watchPoints: separate backup admins, protected vault access, CMEK and isolated recovery credentials
Confirm Backup and DR Service supported services, locations, limits and required service agents before enforcement.
Backup and DR Service is one layer of defense and does not replace application authorization, secure design or human governance.

Include logging, storage, scanning, key operations, network and downstream response/recovery services.
Track cost against protected assets, evaluated requests, retained evidence or recoverable data.

a successful backup is not proven recovery; test application-consistent restores and regional failure procedures — use when its stated fit dominates.
